title: Sap
body:
Sap is a small orange translucent crystal-like shaped object. It is known to spawn either attached to trees (It prefers spawning on Red Maple tree, which is usually found in meadows and grasslands) but however it is mainly seen dropped on the ground near trees. It sells for 80$ in its freshly harvested form, and 320$ in it’s jam form. The jam takes a glass effect, making it look more viscose and fluid.

In-game description:

"A sticky, nourishing fluid that flows through trees, used for food and crafting."


(For future editors, im not sure if thats all that sap can do, description says it used for crafting but i could not find any craft with that item)
